stem.text: A ripple tank and a barrier with a single gap are used to demonstrate the diffraction of surface ripples on water. Initially, the wavelength of the ripples is five times smaller than the gap in the barrier.

stem.alt: Straight water ripples moving right towards a barrier with a single gap; labels: barrier, gap, ripples.

stem.text: Which change increases the amount of diffraction observed?

A.text: double the amplitude of the ripples

B.text: double the width of the gap

C.text: halve the frequency of the ripples

D.text: halve the wavelength of the ripples
